title: Develop and manage employee measures
goal: The venture has a few people measures, each with a written definition, the records it is read from, its period and who reads it, each one read for the current period or named as one the records cannot yet produce.

steps.do: Propose the few measures the venture's people decisions actually need, each tied to the telos measure kinds cost_or_time_saved or compliance_met, and drop every measure no decision would use.
Write each measure's definition, the records and fields it is read from, the period it covers, how a missing value is treated and who reads it, so that two runs a month apart give comparable numbers.
Read each measure for the current period from those records, show the arithmetic, and say which measures the records cannot yet produce and what record would be needed.

Open a decision for each measure the venture should start keeping a record for, add the readings as evidence to the decisions they bear on, and tell the strategy lead which measure is worth the most and costs the least to read.

done_criteria.check: Does every measure name its definition, its records and its period precisely enough that a second run would produce the same number?
